description: Multi-agent strategic foresight platform. Monorepo TypeScript: Hono API + React frontend + PostgreSQL + pgvector. 9 AI agents (Claude claude-opus-4-7) running MSEF/GRUMBACH/GODET methodologies.

monorepo.criticalConstraint: packages/tools CANNOT import @olympus/db (compiles before db). Tools that need DB access go in apps/api/src/tools/

stack.containers: Docker Compose — 3 services: olympus_db, olympus_api, olympus_web

criticalRules.rule: NEVER use Zod in Agent.ts for tool schemas
criticalRules.reason: Dual-package hazard in monorepo — instanceof ZodObject fails silently across package boundaries
criticalRules.correct: Use plain JS objects in TOOL_JSON_SCHEMAS dict, wrapped with jsonSchema() from Vercel AI SDK

criticalRules.rule: After creating tool(), manually inject inputSchema
criticalRules.reason: @ai-sdk/anthropic reads tool.inputSchema, not tool.parameters. Without this, execute() is never called
maxSteps was removed in ai@6.0.168. Default is stepCountIs(1) — only 1 step, no synthesis

criticalRules.rule: Use prepareStep to set toolChoice 'required' only on step 0
criticalRules.reason: toolChoice 'required' on all steps blocks synthesis — HERMES loops until limit with empty response.text

criticalRules.rule: Dockerfile CMD must point to dist/, never tsx
NEVER add blocks that exempt HERMES from using tools
criticalRules.reason: LLM follows most recent instruction when conflict exists — exception overrides the absolute rule

criticalRules.rule: Each .env variable must be on its own line
criticalRules.reason: Literal \n concatenates variables — API keys become malformed, causing HTTP 403
Unlimited history causes context bloat — responses degrade from 5k chars to 500 chars over conversation

projects.notes: deletedAt enables soft deletes. panelToken stores JWT for client panel URL.

agents.notes: Managed via DB — prompts updated on each request via getOrSeedMethodology()

embeddings.notes: pgvector extension required. Voyage AI voyage-3-lite, 512 dims.

database.importPattern: import { db, projects, messages, agents, methodologies, indicators, embeddings, users, tools } from '@olympus/db'; import { eq, asc, desc, and, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm';

stages.1: SCOPUS — Escopo (Ficha: Tema, Horizonte, QEC, Atores, Fronteiras, Premissas, Mudanças, Fontes)
stages.3-4: PYTHIA — Incertezas → 2 eixos críticos → Matriz 2×2 → Q1-Q4 (prob %)
stages.5: MNEMOSYNE — Narrativas (7 componentes, min 400 words, no 'irá'/'certamente')
stages.6: THEMIS — Implicações × dimensão + tabela alertas precoces 🟡/🔴

consultar_agente.notes: agent_name has NO enum — accepts any string to support HERMES_GRUMBACH, HERMES_GODET

buscar_documentos_internos.notes: Lives in apps/api (not packages/tools) because it imports @olympus/db

painel: GET /painel/project/:id (auth via ?token= or Bearer — renders full HTML dashboard)

addNewRoute: 3. Add JWT guard if needed (already global for /api/v1/*)
4. Rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache api && docker compose up -d api
addNewTool: 1. If tool needs DB: create in apps/api/src/tools/mytool.ts
1. If tool is standalone: create in packages/tools/src/mytool.ts
2. Add schema to TOOL_JSON_SCHEMAS in packages/core/src/Agent.ts
3. Add tool name to agent toolsConfig in seed.ts
4. Implement execute() in chat.ts tool handler
5. Rebuild with --no-cache (core changes require full rebuild)
addNewAgent: 1. Add agent definition in apps/api/src/scripts/seed.ts (defaultAgents array)
2. Add or update methodology agentsConfig in defaultMethodologies
4. No rebuild needed — agents/methodologies are DB-driven
addNewIndicator: 1. Agent KRATOS detects indicators from analysis text
2. Or: POST /api/v1/indicators with { projectId, name, source, parametersJson }
3. KRONOS cron job calls KRATOS on schedule (kratosCron field in projects)
patterns.dbQuery: Always use Drizzle ORM. Import { db, table } from '@olympus/db'. Use eq(), and(), isNull() from 'drizzle-orm'.
